Thanks again for taking time today — really appreciate the thoughtful conversation. I wanted to capture the key pain points, goals, and a proposed Mutual Action Plan (MAP) so we’re all aligned on next steps. I attached a first-pass MAP (ACME-MAP-v0.1.xlsx).

Quick recap of what I heard:
- Primary pain: unacceptably high latency and inconsistent throughput for your customer-facing summarization service when usage spikes (esp. 30–60s SLA breaches during peak).
- Secondary pain: cost unpredictability — current per-request spikes during peak windows push forecasting off by ~40%.
- Constraints: data residency for EU customers (but initial scope is US), procurement prefers a single vendor contract with SLAs, security needs SOC 2 evidence and a short data retention policy.

Goals / success criteria:
- Reliable p95 latency under 1.5s for 512-token calls at 10 QPS sustained
- Predictable monthly spend within +/-10% of forecast
- Completed POC that validates latency + cost model for production rollout

Stakeholders we discussed:
- Jake Holloway, CTO (decision lead)
- Priya Sinha, Product (POC owner)
- Amar Patel, Procurement (contracts)
- Marissa Cole, Redwood AE (commercial/coordination)
- Rishi Malhotra, Redwood Solutions Eng (technical lead)

Decision process & timeline (as discussed):
- Product/engineering to complete POC evaluation (Priya/Jake)
- Procurement to finalize commercial terms after POC (Amar)
- Target decision date: mid-March (aiming for contract signature by 2026-03-20)

Proposed Mutual Action Plan (high level):
- Feb 9 — POC kickoff (environment access, test dataset, success metrics) — owners: Priya / Rishi
- Mar 1 — POC completion & results review (latency, cost, edge cases) — owners: Priya / Marissa
- Mar 10 — Procurement/Legal review start (redlines, SOW) — owner: Amar
- Mar 20 — Contract signature / purchase order issued — owner: Amar
- Apr 15 — Production pilot begins (limited traffic) — owners: Priya / Rishi

Attachments: ACME-MAP-v0.1.xlsx (attached) — includes milestone dates, success metrics, and a short rollout checklist.

Open asks from our side:
1) Please confirm that the stakeholders/dates above look right.
2) Please share any procurement templates or required contract language (Amar) so Rishi/Neha and I can review ahead of time.
3) Provide a sample test dataset (or a description of traffic shape) for the POC so we can size the environment.

I’ll follow up with a calendar invite for the Feb 9 kickoff once we confirm timing.

Best,
